_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits at Disbelief ceiling on a rising leg that does not relocate it; absent ETF-flow/funding impulse or momentum break, the coil is the base-rate honest call.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split: analyst explicit HOLD in Disbelief; narrative supply-to-exchange story leans distributional but does not force a phase jump
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-65, options skew stays extreme, 30d momentum remains low-single to high-single grind without ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding >65 and Fear & Greed >70 with positive ETF flows (up into Hope), or 30d momentum negative and Fear & Greed <50 (down into Complacency)
